payload.name: Pet-enhancement bias
payload.fact: Individuals exhibit a pet-enhancement bias, where they rate their own pets more favorably than the average pet on desirable and undesirable personality traits.

provenance.title: Reigning Cats and Dogs: A Pet-Enhancement Bias and Its Link to Pet Attachment, Pet-Self Similarity, Self-Enhancement, and Well-Being
provenance.quote_or_locus: Participants rated their own pet more favorably than the average pet, revealing a pet-enhancement bias
